title: Canonical derived pullback tensor comparison is realized by a monoidal structure
statement: For a scheme morphism g:T→X and a family τ of derived pullback tensor comparison morphisms satisfying IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g τ, there exists a core-monoidal structure m on derivedPullback g such that (m.μIso A B).inv = τ A B for every pair A B of schemeDerivedCategory X.

source.place: Tag 079U, lemma-pullback-tensor-product; perfect.tex, Tag 0DJA(1), transport of the canonical comparison through the derived monoidal model

proof.text: Take a core-monoidal model m with its module functor F, module tensorator, left-derived counit epsilon, chain isomorphisms phi and K-flat coordinate equation. Identify F with Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback by CategoryTheory.Functor.ext on the recorded object and arrow equalities.

The shared counit is also left-derived. Functor.leftDerivedUnique gives delta from the model counit to the shared counit, with delta.hom at Q(P) followed by the shared counit equal to epsilon at P. Transport m with Functor.Monoidal.coreMonoidalTransport delta, which transports the unit as well as the tensorator.

Verify the canonical predicate for the inverse transported tensorator: use phi on each K-flat pair; its degreewise pinning follows by rewriting the module tensorator. Cancel the original tensorator hom in the model coordinate equation. Expand the transported inverse tensorator; tensor composition and the two counit equalities replace its output composites by epsilon. Cancel delta.hom at Q(P) tensor Q(N), use naturality at the localization tensor map, and replace delta.hom followed by the shared counit on the total complex by epsilon. The result is precisely the original coordinate equation. OplaxMonoidal.delta_natural gives naturality in both inputs.

Apply IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison.unique to the verified inverse transported tensorator and the given tau. Evaluate the equality of families at each A and B, and return the transported core-monoidal structure.

from.place: Step 3: identify the qcqs composite with the canonical tensor comparison

lean.statement: theorem canonicalPullbackTensor_monoidal_realization [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))] {T X : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X) (τ : ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X, (derivedPullback g).obj (A ⊗ B) ⟶ (derivedPullback g).obj A ⊗ (derivedPullback g).obj B) (hτ : IsCanonicalPullbackTensorComparison g τ) : ∃ m : (derivedPullback g).CoreMonoidal, ∀ A B : schemeDerivedCategory X, (m.μIso A B).inv = τ A B
lean.note: The tensorator is fixed by τ; its unit is fixed by monoidal unit coherence, so the existential is not an arbitrary witness of unpinned data.
